module mod_radix_sort
  implicit none
  integer, private, parameter :: intkind = 8
  integer, private, parameter :: nbit = 8
  integer, private, parameter :: upper = lshift(1, nbit) - 1
contains
  subroutine radix_sort(a)
    integer(intkind), intent(inout) :: a(:)
    integer(intkind), allocatable :: queue(:, :)
    integer :: n, m, i, j, k, cnt(0:upper)
    n = size(a)
    m = 0
    do i = 0, 8 * intkind - 1, nbit
      cnt = 0
      do j = 1, n
        k = and(rshift(a(j), i), upper)
        cnt(k) = cnt(k) + 1
      end do
      m = max(m, maxval(cnt))
    end do
    allocate(queue(m, 0:upper))
    do i = 0, 8 * intkind - 1, nbit
      cnt = 0
      do j = 1, n
        k = and(rshift(a(j), i), upper)
        cnt(k) = cnt(k) + 1
        queue(cnt(k), k) = a(j)
      end do
      k = 0
      do j = 0, upper
        if (cnt(j) == 0) cycle
        a(k + 1:k + cnt(j)) = queue(1:cnt(j), j)
        k = k + cnt(j)
      end do
    end do
  end
end module mod_radix_sort
program voting_judges
  use mod_radix_sort
  integer :: n, v, p, i, l, r, x
  integer(8) :: m, s, a(100000) = 0, y
  read(*,*) n, m, v, p
  read(*,*) a(1:n)
  call radix_sort(a(1:n))
  a(1:n) = a(n:1:-1)
  l = p
  r = n + 1
  do i = p + 1, n
    if (a(i) + m < a(p)) then
      r = i
    end if
  end do
  do while (r - l > 1)
    x = (l + r) / 2
    s = sum(a(x) + m - a(p:x - 1))
    y = max(m * (v - p - n + x), 0_8)
    if (s < y) then
      r = x
    else
      l = x
    end if
  end do
  write(*,'(i0)') l
end program voting_judges

inline bool cmp(int a,int b){return a>b;}
inline bool chck(int k){
	int t=a[k]+m,pk=min(p-1,k-1);
	//printf("%d %d\n",t,pk);
	ll sum=0;
	for(int i=1;i<=pk;++i){
		sum+=m;
	}
	for(int i=pk+1;i<=n;++i){
		if(a[i]>t) return 0;
		sum+=min(t-a[i],m);
	}
	//printf("%d:%d\n",k,sum);
	return sum>=1ll*m*v;
}

	int l=1,r=n,mid;
	while(l<=r){

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,m,v,p] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  as <- do
    as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
    as <- VU.unsafeThaw as_
    vait_sortBy (compare `on` Down) as
    VU.unsafeFreeze as
  print $ p + query n m v (VU.drop (p-1) as)
  return ()

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
query n m v as = binSearch 0 (VU.length as)
  where
    asSum = VU.scanl' (+) 0 as
    binSearch le gt | gt - le <= 1 = le
                    | ok           = binSearch iSame gt
                    | otherwise    = binSearch le iSame
      where mid = le + (gt - le) `shiftR` 1
            (!ok,!iSame) = testOK mid
    testOK i = (ok, if ok then i1 else i0)
      where
        !ok = VU.head as <= as VU.! i0 + m
              && asSum VU.! i0 <= i0 * as VU.! i0 + m * (n-v)
        i0 = maybe 0 (i-) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.reverse $ VU.take i as
        i1 = maybe (n-1) (i+) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.drop (i+1) as

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  fromIntegral $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

#undef vec_writes3
#undef vec_writes4
#undef FILTERED
#undef FILTER

-- Inconsistent with Show
instance (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b) => ShowAsBuilder (a,b) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTupAsBuilder
instance (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c) =>
  ShowAsBuilder (a,b,c) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTup3AsBuilder
instance (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  ShowAsBuilder (a,b,c,d) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTup4AsBuilder

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLn, v2BSpcSep, v2BConcat, v2BLines ::
  (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLn) = v2BSpcSepLnWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BSpcSep) = v2BSpcSepWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BConcat) = v2BConcatWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BLines) = v2BLinesWith showAsBuilder


v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostf) = (`v2BSpcSepPostfWith` showAsBuilder)

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

IL(evalVals) :: [a] -> [a]
evalVals xs = build $ \c n -> foldr (c $!) n xs
IL(forceVals) :: (NFData a) => [a] -> [a]

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,m,v,p] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  as <- do
    as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
    as <- VU.unsafeThaw as_
    vait_sortBy (compare `on` Down) as
    VU.unsafeFreeze as
  print $ p + query (n-p+1) m (n-v) (VU.drop (p-1) as)
  return ()

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
query n m dv as = binSearch 0 (VU.length as)
  where
    asSum = VU.scanl' (+) 0 as
    binSearch le gt | gt - le <= 1 = le
                    | ok           = binSearch iSame gt
                    | otherwise    = binSearch le iSame
      where mid = le + (gt - le) `shiftR` 1
            (!ok,!iSame) = testOK mid
    testOK i = (ok, if ok then i1 else i0)
      where
        !ok = VU.head as <= as VU.! i0 + m
              && asSum VU.! i0 <= i0 * as VU.! i0 + m * dv
        i0 = maybe 0 (i-) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.reverse $ VU.take i as
        i1 = maybe (n-1) (i+) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.drop (i+1) as

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}

                  (BSB.byteString separator)

  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix

  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,m,v,p] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  as <- do
    as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
    as <- VU.unsafeThaw as_
    vait_sortBy (compare `on` Down) as
    VU.unsafeFreeze as
  print $ p + query n m v (VU.drop (p-1) as)
  return ()

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
query n m v as = binSearch 0 (VU.length as)
  where
    asSum = VU.scanl' (+) 0 as
    binSearch le gt | gt - le <= 1 = le
                    | ok           = binSearch iSame gt
                    | otherwise    = binSearch le iSame
      where mid = le + (gt - le) `shiftR` 1
            (!ok,!iSame) = testOK mid
    testOK i = (ok, if ok then i1 else i0)
      where
        !ok = VU.head as <= as VU.! i0 + m
              && asSum VU.! i0 <= i0 * as VU.! i0 + m * (n-v)
        i0 = maybe 0 (i-) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.reverse $ VU.take i as
        i1 = maybe (n-1) (i+) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.reverse $ VU.drop (i+1) as

  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

instance (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b) => ShowAsBuilder (a,b) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTupAsBuilder

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

import Data.List
import Data.Array

main = do
  n:m:v:p:_ <- map read . words <$> getLine :: IO [Int]
  as <- map read . words <$> getLine :: IO [Int]
  putStrLn $ show $ n - count n m v p as

count n m v p as = length $ filter f [0..n-p]
    where bs = array (0, n-1) $ zip [0..n-1] $ sort as
          f i = g $ foldl (\k -> \j -> if bs ! i == bs ! j then j else k) i [i..n-1]
          g j | v - j - p <= 0 = (bs ! j) + m < bs ! (n-p)
              | otherwise      = (bs ! j) + m < bs ! (n-p) || (v - j - p) * m > foldl (\x -> \k -> x + m + (bs ! j) - (bs ! k)) 0 [j+1..n-p]

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,m,v,p] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  as <- do
    as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
    as <- VU.unsafeThaw as_
    vait_sortBy (compare `on` Down) as
    VU.unsafeFreeze as
  print $ p + query (n-p+1) m v (VU.drop (p-1) as)
  return ()

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
query n m v as = binSearch 0 (VU.length as)
  where
    asSum = VU.scanl' (+) 0 as
    binSearch le gt | gt - le <= 1 = le
                    | ok           = binSearch iSame gt
                    | otherwise    = binSearch le iSame
      where mid = le + (gt - le) `shiftR` 1
            (!ok,!iSame) = testOK mid
    testOK i = (ok, if ok then i1 else i0)
      where
        !ok = VU.head as <= as VU.! i0 + m
              && asSum VU.! i0 <= i0 * as VU.! i0 + m * (n-v)
        i0 = maybe 0 (i-) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.reverse $ VU.take i as
        i1 = maybe (n-1) (i+) $ VU.findIndex (/= as VU.! i)
          $ VU.drop (i+1) as

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  fromIntegral $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

-- Inconsistent with Show
instance (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b) => ShowAsBuilder (a,b) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTupAsBuilder
instance (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c) =>
  ShowAsBuilder (a,b,c) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTup3AsBuilder
instance (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  ShowAsBuilder (a,b,c,d) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTup4AsBuilder

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLn, v2BSpcSep, v2BConcat, v2BLines ::
  (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLn) = v2BSpcSepLnWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BSpcSep) = v2BSpcSepWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BConcat) = v2BConcatWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BLines) = v2BLinesWith showAsBuilder


v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostf) = (`v2BSpcSepPostfWith` showAsBuilder)

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)

def solve(n, m, v, p, a)
  a = a.sort.reverse
  a.unshift nil

  xmin = 0
  xmax = n + 1
  loop do
    break if xmin + 1 == xmax
    x = ((xmin + xmax) / 2).floor
    r = if x <= p
          true
        elsif a[x] + m < a[p]
          false
        else
          b = [0]
          1.upto(n) do |i|
            if p <= i && i < x
              b[i] = a[x] + m - a[i]
            else
              b[i] = m
            end
          end
          b.inject(:+) >= m * v
        end

    if r
      xmin = x
    else
      xmax = x
    end
  end
  return xmin
end

  a = a.sort.reverse

    break if xmin + 1 == xmax

          false

            end
          end
          b.inject(:+) >= m * v
        end

    if r
      xmin = x
    else
      xmax = x
    end
  end
  return xmin

        // 残りについては a[mid]+m を超えない範囲の人数が投票してもok
        else $cnt += min($m, $a[$mid] + $m - $a[$i]);
    }
    if ($cnt >= $m * ($v - 1)) $ok = $mid;
    else $ng = $mid;

  let acc = Array.make (n + 1) 0 in

Scanf.scanf "%d %d %d %d" (fun n m v p ->
    let a = Array.init n (fun _ -> Scanf.scanf " %d" (fun a -> a)) in
    Array.sort (fun a b -> compare b a) a;

    let judge x =
        if a.(x) + m < a.(p - 1) then false else
            let s = n - 1 - x + 1 + p - 1 in
            if s >= v then true else
                let rec loop k sum =
                    if k = x then sum else loop (k + 1) (sum + a.(x) + m - a.(k))
                in
                loop p (m * s) >= m * v
    in

    let rec bin left right =
        if left = right then left else
            let mid = left + (right - left) / 2 in
            if judge mid then bin (mid + 1) right
                         else bin left mid
    in
    let k = bin p n in
    Printf.printf "%d\n" @@ if judge k then k + 1 else k
)

proc parseInnerType(x: NimNode): NimNode =
  newIdentNode("parse" & x[1].repr)

proc inputAsTuple(ty: NimNode): NimNode =
  result = nnkStmtListExpr.newTree()
  t := genSym()
  result.add quote do: (let `t` = stdin.readLine.split)
  p := nnkPar.newTree()
  for i, typ_tmp in ty.pairs:
    var ece, typ: NimNode
    if typ_tmp.kind == nnkExprColonExpr:
      ece = nnkExprColonExpr.newTree(typ_tmp[0])
      typ = typ_tmp[1]
    else:
      ece = nnkExprColonExpr.newTree(ident("f" & $i))
      typ = typ_tmp
    if typ.repr == "string":
      ece.add quote do: `t`[`i`]
    else:
      parsefn := newIdentNode("parse" & typ.repr)
      ece.add quote do: `t`[`i`].`parsefn`
    p.add ece
  result.add p

macro inputAsType(ty: untyped): untyped =
  if ty.kind == nnkBracketExpr:
    if ty[1].repr == "string":
      return quote do: stdin.readLine.split
    else:
      parsefn := parseInnerType(ty)
      return quote do: stdin.readLine.split.map(`parsefn`)
      #[
        when NimMajor <= 0 and NimMinor <= 18:
          stdin.readLine.split.map(parseInnerType(ty.getType))
        else:
          stdin.readLine.split.map(parseInnerType(ty))
      ]#
  elif ty.kind == nnkPar:
    return inputAsTuple(ty)
  elif ty.repr == "string":
    return quote do: stdin.readLine
  else:
    parsefn := ident("parse" & ty.repr)
    return quote do: stdin.readLine.`parsefn`

proc isOK(x: int): bool =
  let t = V - (x+1)
  if t <= 0: return A[x] + M >= A[^P]
  let x_up = A[x] + M
  let k = P-1 # min(N - A.lowerBound(x_up+1), P-1)
  var tmp = t * M - k * M
  if N - A.lowerBound(x_up+1) >= P: return false
  if tmp <= 0: return true
  for i in x+1..<N-k:
    let l = x_up - A[i]
    if l <= 0: return false
    tmp -= l
    if tmp <= 0: return true
  return false

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

  for a in A:
    var v = 0
    if a > X: v += M; Y -= v; p.inc
    if a < X: v += min(M, X - a); Y -= v
    if p < P - 1: Y -= max(0, M - v); p.inc
  return (p < P and Y <= 0)

    result.inc
  else:
    break

    if a < X: v += min(M, X - a); Y -= v
    if p < P - 1 and v < M: Y -= M - v; p.inc
  return (p < P and Y <= 0)

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))

proc lowerBound*[T, K](a: openArray[T]; key: K; cmp: proc (x: T; k: K): int): int =
  if cmp(a[0], key) >= 0: return 0
  if cmp(a[^1], key) < 0: return a.len
  result = a.low
  var step = a.len
  while step > 0:
    step = step div 2
    if cmp(a[min(result + step, a.high)], key) < 0:
      result += step + 1

proc upperBound*[T, K](a: openArray[T]; key: K; cmp: proc (x: T; k: K): int): int =
  a.lowerBound(key, proc (x:T; k: K): int = return if cmp(x, k) <= 0: -1 else: 1)

proc equalRange*[T, K](a: openArray[T]; key: K; cmp: proc (x: T; k: K): int): int =
  a.upperBound(key, cmp) - a.lowerBound(key, cmp)

proc isOK(i: int): bool =
  var T = 0
  T += i * M # j < i な A[j] は M 足せる
  T += M # A[i] にも M 足せる

  let ubi = A.upperBound(A[i] + M, system.cmp)
  let p = P - (N - ubi) - 1 # 同列のやつで，超えるのを許容できる個数
  T += (N - ubi) * M # 明らかにデカすぎなやつにも M 足せる

  if p < 0:
    return false

  # stderrEcho (T: T, ubi: ubi, i: i)

  let
    s = S[ubi] - S[i + 1]
    C = ubi - (i + 1)

  if M * V <= T:
    return true
  else:
    for j in 1..p:
      T += A[ubi - j] - A[i]
      if M * V <= T:
        return true
    return false

#{{{ findFirst, findLast
proc findFirst(f:(int)->bool, l, r:int):int =
  var (l, r) = (l, r)
  while r - l > 1:
    let m = (l + r) div 2
    if f(m): r = m
    else: l = m
  return r
proc findLast(f:(int)->bool, l, r:int):int =
  var (l, r) = (l, r)
  if not f(l): return -1
  while r - l > 1:
    let m = (l + r) div 2
    if f(m): l = m
    else: r = m
  return l

proc findFirst(f:(float)->bool, l, r: float, eps: float):float =
  var (l, r) = (l, r)
  while r - l > eps:
    let m = (l + r) / 2.0
    if f(m): r = m
    else: l = m
  return r
proc findLast(f:(float)->bool, l, r: float, eps: float):float =
  var (l, r) = (l, r)
  if not f(l): return -float(Inf)
  while r - l > eps:
    let m = (l + r) / 2.0
    if f(m): l = m
    else: r = m
  return l
#}}}

proc solve(N:int, M:int, V:int, P:int, A:seq[int]) =
  var A = A
  A.sort()
  A.reverse
  proc calc(i:int):bool =
    if i <= P - 1: return true
    var B = newSeq[int]()
    t := A[i] + M
    V := V - P
    s := 0
    B = newSeq[int]()
    for j in P - 1..<N:
      if i == j: continue
      B.add(A[j])
    for j in 0..<B.len:
      d := t - B[j]
      if d < 0: return false
      if B.len - j <= V:
        d.min=M
      s += d
    return s >= V * M
  echo findLast(calc,0,N) + 1
  return

#{{{ main function
proc main() =
  var N = 0
  N = nextInt()
  var M = 0
  M = nextInt()
  var V = 0
  V = nextInt()
  var P = 0
  P = nextInt()
  var A = newSeqWith(N, 0)
  for i in 0..<N:
    A[i] = nextInt()
  solve(N, M, V, P, A);
  return

main()

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result
